'''Mustafarian armor'''<ref name="The Wrath of Darth Maul">''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]''</ref> was heat-resistant [[Armor/Legends|armor]] fasioned by the [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarians]] from the discarded shells of [[Lava flea/Legends|lava fleas]],<ref name="Stay on Target" /> worn over a body covering of insulating [[Kubazian fabric]].<ref name="Complete Locations" />
